completeness_definition: Known supplier, tariff schedule, service territory, customer class, billing period/tiers, taxes and fees, source effective date, observed date and source URL are tracked separately.
Regional water/electricity rates do not imply ordinary households can switch to a cheaper supplier outside their address franchise area.

Complete nationwide coverage requires an official dated provider denominator and per-provider tariff statuses, including inaccessible/no-public-tariff entries; current release is researched coverage expansion, not nationwide-complete prices.
Telecom brands are not independent physical networks (e.g. TNT uses Smart); count suppliers/brands separately from mobile network operators.
